en.html:
Kanae"Arre, udhar!? HER you are looking at!?"
Sayo"The delight of pinning a gentleman's gaze to oneself... a woman's ecstasyjoy does not change, however many yearsyears she has accumulated."
Ichijou"Hold it, granny! That word you just used—ambitious, no? Above your grade! Above your post! Have some sense of your position!"
Kageaki"That is... an aloha shirt. The bright pattern suits you very well."
Sayo"Ho ho ho. Mr. Minato is a flatterer."
Kageaki"I only said what I truly think..."
Sayo"...I might believe you, you know?"
Kageaki"As you please."
Sayo"You must not be naughty, young man..."
Kageaki"Naughty is hardly—"
Kanae"O hello! The two of you! We are also here, remember!?"
Ichijou"Minato sir, hosh mein aaiye! Is it heatstroke!? Head boiled? Brain made into stew—is that what has happened!?"
Kageaki"I do not think so."

Kageaki"I do not think so."

香奈枝 「ってそっち見るのかよ!?」
さよ 「殿方の視線を釘付けにするこの快感…… 　女としての悦よろこびは幾歳いくつになっても変わらぬ ものでございます」
一条 「待て婆さんいま変な字使わなかったか？ 　変なっつーか分不相応っつーか立場わきま えてねーっつーか！」
景明 「それは……アロハシャツですね。 　明るい柄が良くお似合いです」
さよ 「ほほほ、お上手ですね。湊斗さまは」
景明 「本心から言ったまでの事……」
さよ 「……信じてしまいますよ？」
景明 「ご随意に」
さよ 「やんちゃをなさってはいけません。 　お若い方……」
景明 「やんちゃなどと……」
香奈枝 「おぉーい！ 　ちょっと待ってよそこの二人ー！」
一条 「湊斗さん、正気に戻ってください！ 　熱射病ですかっ!?　頭沸いたんですかっ!? 脳が煮え立ってシチュー状になってたりしま せん!?」
景明 「していないと思うが」

en.html:
Kageaki"I only praised the Chamberlain's clothing."
Kanae"It did not sound like that at all..."
Ichijou"Dictionary meaning, fine... But between the lines, sir, between the lines there is a whole ocean..."
Kageaki"You speak of difficult matters."
Sayo"Mr. Minato... let us continue this conversation later. When we are alone."
Kageaki"Ji."
Ichijou"THERE! Again you have done it! That gap between the lines, Minato sir!!"
Kanae"Suppose this becomes some strange foreshadowing, and later they insert a strange scenescene—who will take responsibility? Such carelessness, Kageaki!"
